fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications announced three new services on the Baladna platform: company commercial registration, electronic accounts for law firms, and remote renewal of lawyers' practising licences.
The Baldna platform of the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications lists trade and import/export services that users apply for through it.
The Baldna government-institutions and trade category lists 24 services, such as import registration, electronic export contracts and exporter-importer register renewals.
The Baldna listing shows request counts per service, including 79,126 for company and business-name import registration and 11,174 for electronic export contracts.
Columnist Hassan al-Sir reports browsing the Baladna platform and finding 79 digital services from 42 government bodies.
Columnist Hassan al-Sir reports the Baladna platform showing 181,958 completed transactions.
Khartoum State launched commercial licence issuing on the Baldna platform, where applicants complete the application and follow it to issue online.
The Ministry of Industry and Trade announced that citizens and companies can now submit and track commercial and personal import requests entirely online via the Baldna platform.

SUNA reports the Director General of Sudan's Digital Transformation Authority told the UN Governance Innovation Summit in Baku that the Baladna platform brings together more than 46 government institutions and 134 digital services.
